**Detecting Diagonals**

I've just uncovered a significant detail: the 2x2 squares are consistently located along the diagonal of the grid.  I've confirmed their size, with each having a dimension of 2x2, spanning from (0,0) to the lower right of the grid. I'm noting the color of each square, which is also a valuable data point. This pattern of the diagonal seems consistent, so I'm investigating how this applies in the next set.
